headline: Waymo has begun driving in Detroit with no human at the wheel, though only company employees can ride for now.
score_reason: Real driverless start in a new city, confirmed by Waymo and several local outlets; public rides not yet open.
importance_line: Detroit residents will start seeing cars with no driver, but public rides are not open yet and "the near future" is Waymo's own wording with no date.
summary: ClickOnDetroit reports that Waymo rolled out fully driverless driving in Detroit on Tuesday 6 Oct 2026, after months of learning the city and working with local officials. Rides are limited to Waymo employees while the company builds a safety framework, and it says public riders will follow once the technology is validated.
notes: Read via ClickOnDetroit because the Detroit Free Press page was blocked; Freep and other local outlets carry the same story.
